title: DSBE Forum ’26
text:
Keynote
The DSBE Forum brings together current students, alumni, and faculty for an evening of exchange, industry perspectives, and community. We are excited to have Dr. Armin Müller kick off the event with an opening keynote, followed by an open Q&A and discussion.

“Driving AI Transformation in Large Enterprises”
Dr. Armin Müller
Global Head of Data & AI @ Kaufland

title: DSBE Forum ’26
text:
Timeline

17:30 – 18:00 · Doors Open & Arrival
Arrive, grab drinks and pretzels (kindly sponsored by the Friedrich List Foundation), and catch up with fellow attendees.
18:00 – 19:15 · Keynote & Open Q&A
Welcome note, presentation by Dr. Armin Müller, and discussion.
19:15 – 19:45 · Community Insights & Networking
Cross-cohort perspectives, community updates, and short break before heading out.
20:00 – Late · Dinner & Drinks
Dinner at a local Tübingen restaurant (self-pay), followed by drinks in the old town.


Venue & Details: The exact lecture hall and restaurant location will be announced closer to the event date. Please RSVP via the registration button above to secure your spot, and check back on this website anytime for the latest updates.
